text.en: 1. This Act may be cited as the Finance (No. 2) Act

2. The Income Tax Act 1967, the Petroleum (Income
Tax) Act 1967, the Supplementary Income Tax Act
1967, the Stamp Act 1949 and the Service Tax
Act 1975 are amended in the manner specified in
Chapters II, III, IV, V and VI respectively.

CHAPTER II
AMENDMENTS TO THE INCOME TAX ACT 1967

3. (1) Sections 4, 7 and 8 of this Chapter shall have
effect for the year of assessment 1991 and subsequent
years of assessment.

(2) Sections 5 and 6 shall have effect for the year of
assessment 1990 and subsequent years of assessment.
